title: Bronx Cocktail - David Lebovitz Bronx Cocktail recipe
ldIngredientsRaw: 1 ounce freshly squeezed orange juice (or 3/4 ounce orange juice and 1/4 ounce lemon juice)
ldInstructionsRaw: Add the gin, sweet and dry vermouth, orange juice (or orange and lemon juice), and orange bitters, to a cocktail shaker. Fill the shakers two-thirds full with ice, cover and shake vigorously until well-chilled, about 15 seconds.
Strain the mixture into a chilled coupe glass.
